open_questions: When was chest discomfort first reported, and what was its initial description?
What medications were prescribed for chest discomfort, and when were they started?
Was any cardiac investigation (e.g., ECG, troponin, stress test) performed or ordered previously?
What is the full documented history of exertional symptoms, including onset and progression?
Which medications are currently active, and when was the most recent regimen confirmed or adjusted?
Are there documented allergies or reactions relevant to cardiac medications (e.g., beta-blockers, nitrates, aspirin)?
Which medications were started, stopped, held or changed?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?
